remarks: Enjoy the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and modern updates in this beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse. Sunlight fills the open living spaces, highlighted by hardwood flooring throughout the main level and thoughtful upgrades throughout. The renovated kitchen is designed for both everyday living and entertaining, featuring rich cherry cabinetry, granite countertops, a spacious pantry, and a charming breakfast nook. Upstairs, both generously sized bedrooms offer the privacy of en-suite full bathrooms along with abundant closet and storage space. The walk-out lower level opens to a private patio with views of the community pool, creating the perfect spot to relax or entertain. Additional features include an attached one-car garage and a guest parking pass. Ideally located in downtown Stamford, you'll be just moments from the train station, restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and everything the city has to offer. A rare opportunity to enjoy low-maintenance living in an unbeatable location. Schedule your showing today!
